replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
Congratulations! The judges of the map building competition have decided to accept your map, and it may appear in rotations. The following is what we enjoyed about your map:

- Really excellent map! The layout of the map provides amazing gameplay, along with a nice natural look to it.
- Much PvP space is present in the map, and I really love every aspect of it. Good work!!  

Aesthetics -  4/5
Gameplay - 4/5 
Creativity -  3/5

Thank you for submitting your map! I hope you participate in our next building competition!
